expected: prompt App ID and APP_ID in app/.env agree (single source of truth)
actual: app_id_conflict: prompt=2607885157171557191 env=1234567890; stopped before mutation

expected: documented conflict resolution converges: after the user picks the prompt App ID, re-running bootstrap binds it
actual: re-running bootstrap with the chosen prompt App ID re-triggers app_id_conflict because .env still holds the old ID; no authorized overwrite path exists and hand-editing .env is forbidden by SKILL.md — resolution loops forever

expected: SKILL.md documents every flag an invoking agent needs; --workspace redirection is discoverable from the golden workflow section
actual: forward-test agent found --workspace only by reading lib/paths.mjs source; SKILL.md golden workflow omits it, and openai.yaml models the brief differently from SKILL.md examples (appId embedded vs stripped)

expected: zmp deploy exits 0 in passive mode
zmp deploy output contains deployed URL with scheme h5.zdn.vn/zapps/ (deploy_output_unparseable)
actual: zmp deploy exited 0 but no URL matching the scheme was found in output

expected: zmp-cli verifies TLS certificates when calling zmp-api.developers.zalo.me
actual: zmp-cli 4.0.3 sets NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 internally, disabling certificate verification for all its HTTPS calls (Node warning captured in deploy.log); out of lab scope, route to zmp-cli owner

expected: official template build:css script points to existing source files
actual: zaui-fashion (main, observed 2026-08-20) ships stale build:css script referencing src/css/tailwind.css which does not exist; template actually uses tailwind.scss via vite/postcss pipeline; styles.css output is imported nowhere; discovered by official-template-golden case (case workspace evidence is ephemeral, finding is the durable record)

expected: official template builds with plain vite build (agent-usable non-interactive path)
actual: zaui-fashion has vite root ./src but index.html only at app root referencing /src/app.ts; plain pnpm exec vite build fails without zmp CLI internal handling; harness preps src/index.html conditionally and records this finding on every prep

expected: render oracle fails a mounted-but-empty app (no blank marker pages pass, plan §8)
actual: official-template profile passed zaui-fashion static render although #app had 0 children and 0 text: ZMPRouter production basename zapps/window.APP_ID never matches at /, app renders empty without errors; profile lacked a content gate and serve path lacked the host URL contract

expected: run.mjs prints each stage status once and is cwd-independent
actual: bootstrap status JSON printed twice at start (cosmetic dup); run.mjs relies on cwd = skill dir for relative stage paths — agent hosts with cwd reset would fail

expected: SKILL.md exit-code table classifies every user-question path under one consistent rule; golden synopsis lists all mandated flags
actual: needs_template_choice exits 3 but table defines 3 as config error while 2 is the ask-user class; --invoked-via mandated but absent from golden synopsis

expected: runner sim demo checks respect per-API requiresPermission from the mock registry
actual: sim_demo_getAccessToken fails in deny/manual modes: getAccessToken has requiresPermission:false (SDK >=2.35 default-granted) so no error marker in deny mode and no sheet in manual mode; runner assumed uniform permission behavior across the 4 demo APIs

expected: SKILL.md documents every sim flag an agent needs (--verify-sim/--preview-sim in synopsis, --sim-decision named) and states which mode produces the badge gate
actual: sim flags missing from golden synopsis; --sim-decision undocumented (agent found it only in run.mjs source, would never exercise deny mode); docs promise sim_sheet_badge but only manual mode asserts it

expected: sim runs leave visual evidence of the permission sheet and account tab
actual: screenshots are captured before demo interaction; sheet/badge/deny-UI evidence is textual only

expected: server_side_api_scan scans only app SOURCE files
actual: scanner walked src/ recursively and flagged built bundle src/www/assets/index.*.module.js (official templates build INTO src/www) — bundled zmp-sdk legitimately contains graph.zalo.me strings, causing a blocking false positive on every built official-template app; real user run in Codex workspace

expected: sim shim provides wrapper-equivalent globals so ZMPRouter-based official templates render (window.APP_ID)
actual: shim reads CFG.appId for its permission store but never sets window.APP_ID; official templates (zaui-fashion) compute ZMPRouter basename zapps/window.APP_ID -> undefined -> no route matches -> blank gray page in preview --sim; lab-template sim cases could not catch this (no router); real repro from user's Codex session

expected: sim answers the full SDK login/permission chain shape- and version-correctly, and blocked external widgets degrade gracefully
actual: three shim gaps found via real Codex usage: (1) auth-settings response double-nested (SDK resolves {authSetting: m.data} so data must be the flat authSetting); (2) authorize rejected -1404 CLIENT_NOT_SUPPORT — SDK version scheme treats <24112000 as legacy epoch (android code = version%10000; sim UA 24000000 -> code 0) and shim lacked host hooks window.zaloVersionCode/window.isAPISupport which SDK checks first; (3) safety-net returned raw JSON to iframe destinations (OA widget) rendering as broken text mid-page
